user.title: Connect MediaVault
user.description: Create an integration key in MediaVault → Settings → Integrations → Home Assistant. Use the server base URL; prefer HTTPS outside your LAN.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect MediaVault
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new key for the same MediaVault server and profile.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure MediaVault
reconfigure.description: Change the address or key, keeping the same server and profile.

error.invalid_auth: The integration key was rejected. Create a new key in MediaVault.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to a compatible MediaVault server. Check the address and server version.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) server URL without a path, username or query parameters.
error.wrong_account: This is a different server or profile. Add it as a separate integration.

abort.already_configured: This MediaVault server and profile are already configured.
